title: feat(plugin-detail): a record:details section heading fills its {{ count }} hole from `count: { field }` (objectui#12192)
body:
Fixes #12192
Clause-②: yes — a newly declared key (`sections[].count`, `@objectstack/spec` 18) reaches the renderer, which widens what `record:details` accepts; `@object-ui/types` mirrors it. A contract review is owed before the queue.

## What this does

A `record:details` section that declares `count: { field }` now has the `{{ count }}` hole in its heading filled with how many values that field holds on the current record. `{ name: 'tagging', label: '{{ count }} tags', count: { field: 'tags' }, fields: ['tags'] }` reads `3 tags` with three tags selected.

- **Where.** The one place the heading text is produced: `RecordDetailsRenderer` (`packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx`), right after the label is resolved (`pickLocalized`) and translated (`sectionLabel`). `DetailSection.tsx` draws `section.title` as given and needs no change. The dispatch named both files; this is the measured producer.
- **The hole grammar** is the spec's exported `SECTION_HEADING_COUNT_HOLE`. The renderer builds its own global copy from `.source`, as the spec's comment asks. No second grammar exists here.
- **The count.** An empty value counts 0, as the spec states. Emptiness is `hasCellValue`, this page's single definition, so the heading never counts a value its body draws as `No value`. An array counts its entries. Any other non-empty value counts 1, because the body draws it as one badge. See the open question below.
- **The record read** is `data`, the record as the viewer may read it (`withoutDeniedFields`). So a field the policy denies counts 0, never its hidden values.
- **No special case.** Nothing is keyed on a section, object or field name. There is no `plan_gap` branch.
- **Registry manifest** (`packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`). The `sections` input description said "This renderer does not read it yet, so a heading carrying the hole prints it as literal text". This PR makes that false, so the sentence now describes the behaviour.
- **`@object-ui/types`.** `RecordDetailsComponentProps.sections[]` is a closed type, so a typed section literal carrying `count` was TS2353. It now declares `count?: { field: string }`, pinned `Equal` to the spec's `z.input` type.
- **Docs.** The `@object-ui/plugin-detail` README gains a subsection. The changeset `.changeset/12192-section-heading-count.md` is `minor` for `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/types`.

## The PM's mechanism assumptions, measured on the installed `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.0`

1. **Shape.** `count` is `strictObject({ field })`, where `field` matches `^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$`. `SECTION_HEADING_COUNT_HOLE` is `/\{\{\s*count\s*\}\}/` and is non-global. The `count` describe gives the field's values as follows: a multi-value field (`multiselect`, `checkboxes`, `tags`, or `select` / `lookup` / `user` / `file` / `image` with `multiple: true`), and "an absent or empty value counts 0".
   - At parse, `sectionHeadingCountRefinement` refuses four cases: `count` beside `group`; `count` with no `label`; a label variant with no hole; a single-brace `{count}` or a foreign `{{ x }}`.
   - A hole in a section without `count` is NOT refused.
   - Whether `count.field` exists and is multi-valued is a lint question (`page-field-unknown`, `page-section-count-not-multi-value`, ERROR). The spec says nothing about what a single-valued field counts at runtime.
2. **Where the label is translated.** `rawTitle = pickLocalized(s.label, language)`, then `sectionLabel(objectName, s.name, rawTitle ?? s.name)`. The bundle arm goes through i18next 26.4.0 `t()` with no `count` variable, and it keeps the hole: `skipOnVariables` is on by default, and `createI18n` sets no `missingInterpolationHandler`. Filling after both steps covers the authored text, the inline map and the bundle. The pins below show this in `en` and in `zh`.
3. **Cloud's collapsed, absent-when-empty section.** The count does not change it. `count` touches only `title`. Whether a section renders is still `hideEmpty ?? true` with `DetailSection`'s all-empty early return. Pinned: a collapsible, `defaultCollapsed` section over an empty field is absent, and over a filled field it shows the count while collapsed. ⚠️ Cloud's own metadata (objectstack-ai/cloud PR 2784) was NOT MEASURED: the session has no access to that repo (`add_repo` refused). The pin models the shape the card body describes.

## Tests (all at `1a983e8b7`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` (echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (all three legs): exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/`: 267 files passed, 1 skipped. 2597 tests passed, 14 skipped.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/`: 377 files and 10258 tests passed.
- The 8 app-shell suites that render or configure `record:details` sections (derived by grep): 149 tests passed.
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: 255 tests passed.
- **New render pins**, through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registration: `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.sectionHeadingCount-12192.test.tsx`, 14 tests. They cover:
  - three values read 3;
  - every hole is filled, with any inner whitespace;
  - a lookup array counts its records;
  - an empty array, and an absent value, read 0;
  - a denied field reads 0, with a control on another field;
  - the collapsed section is absent when empty and shows its count while collapsed;
  - with no `count`, a literal hole and a plain heading print unchanged;
  - an inline map fills in `zh` and `en`, and a `zh` bundle `_sections.NAME.label` entry is filled;
  - a single value counts 1.
- **New type pin**, `packages/types/src/__tests__/record-details-section-count-12192.test.ts`. The mirror is `Equal` to the spec's input type. The bare-name spelling is refused. Spec controls: a counted section parses with `count` kept, and the same section without a hole is refused at `sections.0.label`.

### Ablation and reverse validation (one-time; run after the commit, through `ablation-replace.mjs` with restore proven)

- **Renderer.** The fill call was replaced with `translatedTitle`; the on-disk anchor went 1 to 0 and the blob changed. The new file then read **11 failed, 3 passed**, as predicted beforehand. The 3 that stay green are the no-`count` pair and the absent-when-empty leg. Restored: blob equals HEAD (`37b474722ad2`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Types mirror.** `count?: { field: string };` was deleted. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` then reported 3 errors (TS2339 and TS2353) in the new type pin. Restored: blob equals HEAD (`cde183642e74`) and the diff is empty.

### Gates

- **Pass:** `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (5 source files of 2 released packages, 1 changeset); `check:changeset-claims`; `check:pending-changeset-literals`; `check:new-line-citations` (0 new); `check:control-bytes`; `check:test-path-roots`; `check:vi-mock-specifiers`.
- **Pass, derived from the diff:** `check:spec-symbols`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, the doc gates (`check-doc-json-fences`, `check-doc-fence-languages`, `check-doc-component-types`, `check-doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-expression-carriage`, `check-doc-links`), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check-lint-coverage`. The governed-surface guard reads NOT GOVERNED.
- **NOT MEASURED** (prerequisite not met locally; CI builds it):
  - `check:sdui-registration-pins` needs a console build (exit 2).
  - `check:readme-exports` needs every package's `dist` (population floor).
- **Not run:** no `check:i18n-*`, because no translation key was added.
- **ESLint, a proven narrowing.**
  - Population, read from `eslint.config.js`: `**/*.{ts,tsx}` minus the build-output ignores. All 5 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files are inside it.
  - `--format json` counted 5 files: 0 errors and 62 warnings.
  - Per-file base vs head, as errors/warnings: `index.tsx` 0/32 vs 0/32; `record-details.tsx` 0/30 vs 0/30; `record-components.ts` 0/0 vs 0/0. The two new tests are 0/0.
  - Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), and no local rule in `eslint-rules/` reads another file from disk. So this diff cannot move the verdict of any untouched file.

## Open question for the seat

- A single-valued field counts 1. `@objectstack/lint` refuses that field at authoring time, and the spec does not define its runtime count. The renderer counts a non-array value as 1, which agrees with the one badge the body draws. The alternatives are 0, or leaving the hole unfilled. The recommendation is to keep 1 (see the report).

## Acceptance notes (not changed here)

- **Types mirror gap, class (b).** `RecordDetailsComponentProps.sections[]` does not declare `hideEmpty`. The spec declares it, and the renderer honours it.
  - The installed spec parses `{ label, fields, hideEmpty: false }` as success.
  - The same literal typed against the published type is TS2353 on `hideEmpty`. The control, `showBorder`, compiles.
  - This is the same class as the section-member alignment the 8583 type pin records. It goes to the seat to file.
- **The spec describe goes stale when the pin moves.** The spec's `count` describe still carries `[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced]` and "until the record detail renderer reads it, the hole renders as literal text". Its own comment says to drop the marker "in the change that lands the renderer at the `.objectui-sha` pin". Carrier: the objectstack change that moves `.objectui-sha` past this merge.
- **A stale test comment.** `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts` says the renderer half "is held on objectui#12192". The assertion stays correct, because the designer control for `count` is still deferred, like the eight before it. Carrier: whoever builds the section inspector controls. Only the comment goes stale.
- **Not run locally.** The CI-owned `Spec Main Shape Gate` is red on `main` (advisory, not this change). The `OAuthConsentPage` flake is unrelated.
